invariants.rationale: The method expects to operate on non-null input records; usually method contracts require non-null collections.
A HoodieEngineContext is required for distributed operations, so the method likely expects it to be non-null.
The table is required to invoke getIndex() in the method body; passing null would result in failure.
The method declares dedupedRecords as a List, so it should always be an instance of List at entry.
